name: Cordless drill driver 18 V

name: Hammer drill 850 W
description: A corded hammer drill that goes through brick and concrete without effort. Side handle, depth stop and a keyless 13 mm chuck.

name: Compact drill 12 V
description: Small and light for tight spaces and overhead work. Ideal for screws up to 6 mm and drilling in wood and plastic.

name: Circular saw 1200 W
description: Straight, clean cuts in boards up to 55 mm thick. Bevel cuts up to 45 degrees, a parallel guide and a dust port for your vacuum.

name: Cordless jigsaw 18 V
description: Curves, cut-outs and shapes in wood, plastic and thin metal. Tool-free blade change and four pendulum settings.

name: Random orbit sander 300 W
description: Leaves a smooth, swirl-free finish on furniture and doors. Hook-and-loop pads and a built-in dust box.

name: Detail sander
description: A triangular pad that reaches into corners and along edges. Perfect for window frames and chair legs.

name: Claw hammer 450 g
description: A balanced steel claw hammer with a fibreglass handle that absorbs shocks. The curved claw pulls nails cleanly.

name: Rubber mallet
description: Taps tiles, paving and furniture joints into place without marking them.

name: Screwdriver set, 12 pieces

name: Precision screwdriver kit

name: Combination wrench set, 8 to 19 mm

name: Adjustable wrench 250 mm
description: One wrench for nuts up to 30 mm, with a precise worm gear and a scale on the jaw.

name: Wood screws, assorted box
description: Six hundred zinc-plated wood screws in the sizes you use the most, sorted in a box with a clear lid.

name: Stainless deck screws, 200 pieces
description: Rust-free screws for terraces and garden furniture, with a self-drilling tip.

name: Wall plugs, mixed sizes

name: Plasterboard anchors

name: Paint brush set, 5 pieces

name: Angled sash brush
